description: Land Acquisition - Bulathkohupitiya, Bulathkohupitiya D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, claimants, and exact land extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
